title: One API for ChatGPT, Claude & Gemini 🚀 #shorts  #ai #chatgpt #aitutorial #aitools
description:
🚀 Tired of managing multiple AI APIs?

In this video, I explain OpenRouter, a powerful platform that lets you access leading AI models like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Qwen, DeepSeek, Llama, and more through a single API and unified interface.

Whether you're building AI apps, automating workflows, or experimenting with LLMs, OpenRouter simplifies development and helps you switch between models without changing your entire setup.

In this video:
✅ OpenRouter explained
✅ One API for multiple AI models
✅ ChatGPT, Claude & Gemini integration
✅ AI developer workflow
✅ LLM routing
✅ Best AI tool for developers
